title: Maps & Navigation
summary: A maps app does three different jobs. It draws the map from pre-cut vector tiles cached at the edge. It finds routes across a road graph of hundreds of millions of segments in milliseconds, using precomputed shortcuts (contraction hierarchies). And it predicts arrival times from live traffic, measured largely from the GPS traces of the phones that are navigating, which feeds back into every route.

walkthrough.title: Draw the map
walkthrough.text: As the user pans, the app requests vector tiles by zoom/x/y. Tiles are pre-generated and served from a CDN, and the phone renders and styles them itself.

walkthrough.title: Request a route
walkthrough.text: The user asks for directions home. The request includes start, destination, travel mode, and departure time.

walkthrough.title: Search the graph with shortcuts
walkthrough.text: The routing engine searches a road graph with contraction hierarchies, shortcut edges precomputed offline, so a cross-country route explores thousands of nodes instead of millions.

walkthrough.title: Return routes with ETAs
walkthrough.text: Alternatives are scored by predicted travel time using current segment speeds and returned with turn-by-turn instructions.

walkthrough.title: Phones report GPS probes
walkthrough.text: While navigating, phones send anonymised location traces every few seconds.

walkthrough.title: Turn probes into live speeds
walkthrough.text: Traces are map-matched to road segments to compute live speeds. A model blends these with historical patterns to predict speeds for the next hour, and the routing graph's edge weights update every minute.

walkthrough.title: Reroute on the fly
walkthrough.text: If a crash slows the current route and a faster one appears, the app is offered a reroute mid-trip.

data.label: Tile Service & CDN

output.name: Tile
output.type: Compressed roads, labels, buildings for one square

responsibilities: Pre-generates tiles for every zoom level from map data.
Serves almost entirely from CDN cache.
Republishes tiles when map data changes.

failureModes.impact: Missing roads or wrong names everywhere.
failureModes.mitigation: Validation pipelines and staged tile rollouts.

failureModes.scenario: Cache purge after a data release
failureModes.mitigation: Versioned tile URLs instead of purges.

data.label: Routing Engine

output.name: Routes

responsibilities: Finds fastest routes in milliseconds over a continent-sized graph.
Applies restrictions: turns, tolls, truck limits.
Generates alternative routes that are meaningfully different.

failureModes.scenario: Precomputation too slow for live traffic
failureModes.mitigation: Customisable CH: keep the structure, update weights in seconds.
User reports and probe evidence correct the map.

data.label: Probe Ingest & Map Matching

input.name: Probes
input.type: (anon_id, lat, lng, speed, ts) every few seconds

responsibilities: Matches noisy GPS points to the road actually travelled.
Aggregates speeds per segment over short windows.
Detects incidents from sudden slowdowns.

failureModes.scenario: Few probes on a minor road
failureModes.impact: Speed estimates are noisy or missing.
failureModes.mitigation: Fall back to historical speeds; require minimum sample counts.

failureModes.scenario: Fake probes (e.g. 99 phones in a wagon)

data.label: Road Graph

input.name: Weights
input.type: Predicted travel time per edge, refreshed each minute

responsibilities: Holds the road network with attributes and restrictions.
Stores precomputed shortcut edges.
Applies fresh edge weights without rebuilding.

failureModes.mitigation: Alert on staleness; fall back to historical weights.

failureModes.scenario: Road closure not in the graph
failureModes.impact: Users routed into a closed road.
failureModes.mitigation: Ingest closure feeds and probe-detected closures.

data.label: Speed & ETA Models

input.name: Signals
input.type: Live speeds + time of day + events + weather

output.name: Predictions
output.type: Edge travel times for the next hour

responsibilities: Predicts how traffic will evolve, not just how it is now.
Blends live data with typical weekly patterns.
Is measured against actual trip times.

failureModes.mitigation: Event-aware features; weight live data more heavily when patterns break.

failureModes.scenario: Feedback loop: everyone rerouted onto one side street
failureModes.impact: New jam created by the app.
failureModes.mitigation: Spread recommendations; account for routed volume.
